name: wf-caps
description: wf default-capabilities pack — non-core, stack/domain-specific capabilities for the wf workflow, composed with wf core via the capability registry. Ships the migration capability (migration-map: C#/MVC -> Angular/TS mapping). (The browser-qa engine capability was extracted into the standalone wf-browser-qa plugin; the node-ts stack capability into wf-node-ts; the audit and sr capabilities into wf-audit; the angular stack capability into wf-angular.)
